summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The AlphaDroid Broad Markets Momentum ETF (EZMO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund operates as a fund-of-funds. The ETF tracks an index that strategically allocates exposure to broad-based US-listed ETFs, based on overall market conditions and momentum signals EZMO was launched on Oct 15, 2025 and is issued by Teucrium.
